record_scope_reconstruction: Ordinary Afghan passenger entry to Uzbekistan across the combined road–rail Termez–Hairatan Friendship Bridge; freight and authorized/free-zone access have separate status.

source_checks.finding: Retrieved article reports the Chamber of Commerce announcement of restored bridge pedestrian movement after June 2021 suspension, while trucks had remained allowed.
UN report describes the Hairatan Friendship Bridge east of Termez carrying pedestrians, vehicles and railway, supporting shared bridge identity rather than an unrelated town centroid.

sites.name: Termez–Hairatan Friendship Bridge
sites.coordinate_method: Mean of the four unique OSM bridge-outline vertices from fresh way/full XML
sites.precision: Approximately 100 m crossing-area reference on an 800 m bridge; not a distinct customs terminal
sites.evidence_note: Named bridge footprint in fresh OSM XML. Original passenger-restoration source explicitly names the Termez-Hayraton Bridge; the UN Termez report confirms pedestrian, road and rail share this bridge. Only accepted road/passenger phase is bound.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Ordinary Afghan passenger entry to Uzbekistan across the combined road–rail Termez–Hairatan Friendship Bridge; freight and authorized/free-zone access have separate status.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: June–August 2021 bounds preserve conflicting onset retrospectives and may encompass distinct tightening phases. December 2021 operational reporting separately dates complete inward passenger closure from October 29 and outward closure from November 7, while noting possible non-Afghan passage. Those categories and the reverse direction are not timed by this phase. The November 23, 2025 endpoint is the Chamber-confirmed resumption, not the December announcement.

independence_statement: Pass B reconstruction from original-source retrievals and coordinate evidence; no pass A files or judgments consulted.
